notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary attribute and interaction delivery surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies active and passive ordinary attribute Update/Reflect and interaction Send/Receive, parameter and attribute value propagation, user tags, producer identity, transportation metadata, and pre-connect/pre-join send boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary attribute update and interaction send services with FederateAmbassador delivery callbacks
